title: Warner Bros. Water Tower Already Repainted to Add ‘A Skydance Corporation’ After Merger Closes - Variety
description: David Ellison wasted no time in adding the Skydance name to the iconic Warner Bros. water tower in Burbank.

title: NFL Referees Association to challenge officials' suspensions - ESPN
description: The NFL Referees Association said it will challenge the severity of the suspensions of two officials for unprofessional conduct.

title: Arcadia couple at center of surrogacy scandal have been arrested on multiple charges, Eyewitness News has learned - ABC7 Los Angeles
description: Eyewitness News has learned Silvia Zhang and Gunjun Xuan, the Arcadia couple at the center of a surrogacy scandal, have been arrested on multiple charges.

title: Some sugar-free Starbucks drinks have as much sugar as a Kit Kat bar, lawsuit says - NBC News
description: A consumer lawsuit is accusing Starbucks of adding sugar, sometimes as much as that in a Kit Kat bar, to drinks marketed as sugar free.

title: FBI whistleblower says White House pushed unconstitutional probe of protesters - NBC News
description: The former analyst says supervisors were told not to put things in writing, so many of the directives came in face-to-face meetings.
